'''2011 German National Championship Joerg Rautenberg LS Heading For The Medical Frigate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joerg Rautenberg]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' PL2 - Light Side Ground Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
